desc:
⭐Please like/thumbs up and favorite for more updates!

Fight to become the ultimate legend.

We are constantly updating this game and fixing bugs. Don't dislike the game it's kinda buggy and not very playable

Cheating it's permanent ban including alts.

You can play this game on any device! (💻📱🎮)

Keybinds:
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Evasive/Ragdoll Cancel
F - Block
G - Awaken
Left Click - Light Attack
B - Emote Wheel

This game's characters are all stickmen, original or from an anime.

This is not the original game this is a modded version, if any dev of LBG whishes to takedown the game DM (empyreussss)
contact.
